title: Austin Street Repair & Gutter Maintenance 1876
summary:
• **Emergency Meeting Called**: City Council held a special session to address urgent infrastructure issues on Pecan Street, specifically problems with street grading and damaged gutters.

• **Gutter Cleaning Resolution Passed**: Council adopted a resolution requiring the Street Committee and City Engineer to develop and implement a plan to keep gutters clean and prevent waste water from disturbing neighbors.

• **Accountability Focus**: The measure emphasized that city officers must fully discharge their duties to prevent residents from being annoyed by water drainage problems on neighborhood streets.
transcript:
Called Meeting
Council Chamber July 21, 1876

Council called to order at 4.30 P.M.
T.W. Shuster President of Board of Aldermen in the Chair Roll called and the following
members answered, Aldermen Bremond Diffenbaugh Goodale, James, Larmour, Shuts and Taylor.

Absent Aldermen Cook and Robinson
The President informed the Council that they had been called together for the purpose of
taking action relative to the grading or repairing the gutters on Pecan Street Alderman
Taylor introduced the following resolution Resolved by the City Council of the City of
Austin That the Street Committee and City Engineer be required to devise means to keep the
gutters clean and see that the Officers discharge their duties fully in preventing persons
from annoying their neighbors by waste Water Adopted

On motion of Alderman Shuts the Council
adjourned

John St. Herbert
City Clerk
